aboutSection.title: About Our Company
aboutSection.paragraph1: Global Observatory Company for Building Construction is a leading company in waterproofing, concrete repair, and specialty materials. We have exclusive agencies and our own specialized products that ensure the highest standards of quality and performance.
aboutSection.paragraph2: We are proud to have completed many distinguished projects in the State of Kuwait, including waterproofing basements, tanks, swimming pools, water basins, and complete buildings with roofs and basements. Our extensive experience and quality materials have made us the first choice for contractors and real estate developers.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description:
At Global Observatory Company for Building Construction, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide when using our website or contacting us.

Information Collection: We collect basic information such as name, phone number, and email when you contact us to inquire about our services or products.

Use of Information: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, provide price quotes, and keep you informed about our new products and services.

Information Protection: We take appropriate security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction.

Information Sharing: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties except with your consent or when required by law.

Your Rights: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time by contacting us.

For privacy policy inquiries, please contact us via email or phone.
